title: Banpará says it blocked new attack attempts and Pix, suspended after a cyberattack, is restored
date_note: Diário do Pará's report of 25 November says the attack was identified on the night of Monday (23).
geo_basis: Bank named by the source; no city stated in the page, pin at Belém, capital of the bank's home state Pará
summary: Diário do Pará reports that Pix, suspended by Banpará after a cyberattack on an account of the Pará government linked to Sefa, was restored on 26 November. The bank's communications office says new intrusion attempts were contained and did not succeed. President Ruth Mello said on 25 November that part of the money had been recovered. The Polícia Civil is investigating; no access method has been disclosed.
plain: A Brazilian state bank says Pix is working again after being paused following a cyberattack. The bank says new attack attempts failed; the police are investigating.
exec: A bank's instant-payment service was paused after a cyberattack and is restored; the bank says new attempts failed and police are investigating.

validation.note: Only Diário do Pará (two articles, one publisher) read; the bank's statements are as relayed by it, no Banpará own page read.

review.note: title, date, Pix restoration, recovery statement, Sefa account, police checked against both Diario do Para articles
